about.text: A dark, thick sweet from Piura and Lambayeque in northern Peru, eaten warm or cold, from a spoon or as an alfajor filling. It is cooked from milk, chancaca, sugar, cornstarch and spice; the older version used goat's milk, and industrial ones are sold in tins or small wooden boxes.
